title: Business Meeting
subtitle: Speak up in the boardroom
description: Professional meetings demand precise, confident language. These phrases will help you propose ideas, clarify expectations, and keep discussions moving forward like a seasoned professional.
tip: Use 'I'd like to propose' or 'My suggestion would be' instead of just 'I think' — it signals confidence and signals you're ready to own the idea.
phrases: I'd like to propose an alternative approach that could save us significant time.
Before we proceed, could we clarify the deliverables for this phase?
To summarize, we've agreed on three action items with a deadline of Friday.
I'd suggest we schedule a follow-up call to review the initial results.
Could you share the latest figures so we can make an informed decision?
I want to make sure everyone is aligned before we move forward.
That's a fair point — perhaps we could revisit that issue in the next session.
Should we establish a clear owner for each of these action items?
